name: ports
title: Ports
description: Menu bar status and quick toggle for the `ports` CLI — keep AI agents (codex, claude, gemini, cursor) caffeinated and visible at a glance.
author: ericxu

commands.name: menubar
commands.title: Ports Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: ports
commands.description: Show AI agent caffeinate status in the menu bar with one-click toggles.

commands.name: agents
commands.title: AI Agents
commands.subtitle: ports
commands.description: List detected AI agent processes and toggle caffeinate.

preferences.name: binaryPath
preferences.title: Ports Binary Path
preferences.description: Absolute path to the `ports` binary. Leave blank to auto-probe common locations.

preferences.name: agentRoles
preferences.title: Roles to Show
preferences.description: Which `role` values from `ports find` to display. agent = main interactive process. Comma-separated.

preferences.name: extraQueries
preferences.title: Extra AI Agent Queries
preferences.description: Comma-separated extra search terms passed to `ports find` (beyond the built-in codex/claude/gemini/cursor).
